messages:
incident-bot: PAGER ACTIVATION - API Gateway 502/504 spike detected
service: api-gateway-edge
region: us-west-2
error-rate: 5.8% (baseline 0.2%)
requests/min: 12k
alerting at 2026-03-15 03:21:28 UTC
pager: @sre_oncall_maya
Link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abcd123/api-gateway?from=now-15m :rotating_light:

sre_oncall_maya: ack. I'm on it. starting triage. @tom_infra can you confirm infra status?

tom_infra: seeing increased 502s from edge->gateway; nginx upstream failures spike; suspected upstream timeouts. rolling logs:
```
nginx: recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer) while reading response header from upstream
```

aj_prod: customer impact: some customers in eu-west report 502s via proxy; volume ~3% of traffic. adding to status page? :thinking:

sre_oncall_maya: yes create incident page. adding high-level mitigation: 1) enable degraded-mode routing (reduce fanout), 2) increase upstream timeouts, 3) enable circuit-breaker to reject heavy clients. executing step 1.

deploy-bot: command queued: `redwoodctl router set-weight --route api-edge --region us-west-2 --weight 70` executed by sre_oncall_maya

tom_infra: confirmed weight change propagated. traffic to secondary region us-east-1 increased to 30%.

sre_oncall_maya: running quick grep on ingress logs to find top upstream host failing:
```
cat /var/log/nginx/access.log | jq -r '.upstream' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -n 10
```

sre_oncall_maya: top failing upstream is gateway-instance-45 (10% of failures), but failures are across instances.

customer-sre-jenny: we have a high qps client `search-batch` that spikes open connections. can we throttle?

aj_prod: applying rate-limit for that client via config: `rate-limit set --client search-batch --rps 20` — will deploy in 30s.

deploy-bot: rate-limit change deployed.

sre_oncall_maya: temporarily increasing proxy_read_timeout from 30s -> 60s on gateway pool to reduce upstream timeouts. applying via `nginx-conf update`.

tom_infra: update rolled out to 60% gateways. tailing error rate metric...

sre_oncall_maya: error-rate dropped from 5.8% -> 2.1% over 5m. still above baseline. continuing monitoring.

aj_prod: customer impact: partial degradation; support routing customers with retries, informing highest-impact accounts. adding note on status page.

sre_oncall_maya: next step: if error rate doesn't drop further, enable fallback model to lightweight stateless API for non-critical endpoints. Preparing canary config.

customer-sre-jenny: agreed. also put a temporary global 429 throttling for non-authenticated bulk endpoints.

sre_oncall_maya: creating postmortem channel. tagging for follow-up: root cause likely upstream overload from bursty clients + insufficient circuit breaking. Will capture metrics + timeline.

aj_prod: current status: mitigation in-progress, customer impact reduced. ETA for full stabilization: 20-30m. Will update every 5m.

sre_oncall_maya: moving to monitoring-only. handoff to oncall rotation in 30m for watch. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident severity updated to P1 -> Update: mitigations active. Next update scheduled at 2026-03-15 03:30:00 UTC.
